task: Add 10 generated pediatric clinical-branch standard cases after quality and duplication checks
qualityFixesBeforeInsert: Hard duplicate detected and blocked: original duktus-dependent cyanotic newborn/PGE1 case matched an existing pediatrics standard case.
That duplicate was replaced with a new adrenal-crisis pediatric emergency case.
Correct answers were redistributed; generated source had all correct answers at A.
Weak or overly obvious distractors were replaced with clinically plausible same-category alternatives.
OptionComparison feedback was rewritten to match revised options.
